text:
Maria G: Heads-up — we need to nail the UX for the automatic fallback policy before next week's rollout. Ops asked for clearer audit hooks + an operator-friendly override.
Devon K: Agreed. Two blurred things: how we present 'why we fell back' (error vs cost vs quota) and how we surface sampled request payloads for audits.
Sanjay P: For the first, can we have a concise reason + a link to an expanded view? e.g., 'fallback: model-timeout (p95 latency > 3s) -> details'. Avoid dumping raw prompt in the main header.
Jen L: +1. Main banner should be short. Expanded view can show telemetry: trace id, signal snapshot, and sample of the buffered prompt (redacted by default).
Maria G: Ops also wants a quick operator action: ‘retry’, ‘force-primary (30s)’, and ‘snooze autopolicy (5m)’. Those should be gated by RBAC.
Devon K: How do we represent sampling? We can't store every prompt (privacy). Maybe store a hashed id + redaction hint. Keep raw text only for security/compliance enclaves.
Sanjay P: Telemetry schema proposal (short): event.type, decision, trigger_metrics, trace_id, sample_id, retention_tier. Example: `{"event.type":"fallback_decision","decision":"degrade","trigger_metrics":{"model_latency_p95":3120},"trace_id":"t-abc123","sample_id":"s-987"}`
Jen L: That looks good. UI can fetch sample by sample_id with an acl check. If denied, show 'sample restricted — request audit'.
Maria G: UX note: show the decision probability or confidence (if probabilistic), e.g., `autofallback_score: 0.87`. Operator should see if it was borderline vs clear-cut.
Devon K: Also add a small sparkline of recent fallbacks for that route in the header. Quick visual of frequency helps triage.
Sanjay P: Regarding quotas: when fallback is due to quota-backed routing (we routed to a cheaper model), show cost delta and a toggle to resume premium route for N requests. That helps product owners decide.
Devon K: For auditability, we need immutable event logs + link to request traces in observability. Could be `OpenTrace(t-abc123)` that opens Sentry/Jaeger with filters pre-filled.
Jen L: One tricky bit: failed attempts to fetch sample (due to retention) should still show the minimal context: timestamp, route, decision. Don't show empty UI.
Maria G: Can we add a small 'why' checklist for operators: latency, error-rate, cost, quota, manual override? Clickable items expand to the precise metrics that tripped the rule.
Sanjay P: Implementation note for backend: include `why_breakdown` array of short labels + metric snapshots. Eg `why_breakdown:["p95>3s","5% errors","quota-exhausted"]`. UI will render badges.
Devon K: One more: a 'replay this sample' button that sends a sanitized copy to a replay sandbox (only if owners enable). Must require explicit opt-in and audit log.
Jen L: UX microcopy: use 'Degraded to backup model' instead of 'Fallback' in user-facing consoles — less alarmist. Internally we still call it fallback.
Maria G: Good idea. Ops asked for a one-click export of the audit bundle (decision event + trace + sample) as a JSON blob for compliance. Add export button in expanded view.
Sanjay P: We'll need retention tiers: 7d (default), 30d (paid), 365d (enterprise). Make sample retrieval check the retention tier first.
Devon K: Ok next steps: design mocks for header + expanded panel (Jen), telemetry event schema (Sanjay), RBAC/ops flows (Maria), tiny API to fetch sample (Devon). I'll stub the endpoints: `GET /api/v1/fallbacks/:id` and `POST /api/v1/fallbacks/:id/replay`.
Jen L: I'll wire up a small prototype in the console sandbox and ping this thread when it's ready.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: console-sandbox/ux-fallback-panel -> staging at 2025-06-12T17:14:00Z :rocket:
Maria G: Thanks all — aiming for design review by Friday. If anyone has urgent constraints (privacy/regulatory), drop them here now.
Devon K: Noted: EU PII rules require opt-in for raw prompt storage. We'll default to redaction and an explicit consent flow.
Sanjay P: Also pinging security for a brief on KMS access for enterprise retention.
Maria G: Perfect. Closing loop — will add a short runbook snippet to the panel: "If repeated fallback > 10% in 1h, escalate to infra."
